about: Golden record of @usesequential/release-cli 0.2.1 (cli/bin/sequential-release.cjs) before it became a wrapper. Recorded by tests/cli/fixtures/record-golden.cjs: each case ran the bin as a process against fakes on 127.0.0.1.

placeholders.<token>: SEQUENTIAL_RELEASES_TOKEN: a fake project access token (sq_pat_ + 32 letters or digits)
placeholders.<sequential-v6>: the same fake listening on http://[::1]:<port>
placeholders.<github>: the fake GitHub API, https://127.0.0.1:<port> (self-signed certificate trusted through NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS)
placeholders.<repo>: the case git repository (the bin runs with it as cwd)

harnessEnv: Every run: PATH, HOME (an empty temp dir), LANG=C, LC_ALL=C, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, then the case env. No other variable (no GITHUB_*, no SEQUENTIAL_*).
gitSetup: git init -b main; one empty commit per entry with the message given, author and committer "Golden", dates 2026-11-01T00:00:<index>Z; a tag where given.
varyingFields: None after placeholders. The old CLI sends no released_at unless --released-at is given (the server then uses now), so no request field depends on the clock. The undici user-agent header ("node") depends on the Node version.
